reasons.vendor:
Containerized IOS XR control-plane (Cisco's own open-source XRd Control
Plane image) - docker, not qemu. EVE-NG's own xrd.yml: ram 4096, needs
/dev/fuse + SYS_ADMIN/NET_ADMIN + --net=none (netplex's own DockerProvider
already does network_mode=none by default per HARD rule #2, so no
netplex-specific change needed there) and a large MTU (9500) for its
internal linux-networking datapath.
